sources.title: Efficient Attention in Language Models
sources.snippet: This survey reviews efficient attention mechanisms for large language models, focusing on linear and sparse attention methods that address the computational challenges of traditional self-attention. It categorizes linear attention into kernelized, recurrent, and fast-weight approaches, while sparse attention includes fixed-pattern, block, and clustering techniques.
